normalization.ids: Synthetic seed IDs; renderer UUIDs increment from 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 in invocation order.
normalization.runtimeGeneration: Replace each actual database generation UUID by fixture-generation-<database seed name>, preserving identity across all events and snapshots.

normalization.layout: Layout maps are serialized by ordered keys and session IDs. Tuple columns are explicit for the 10,000-node case. Render realNodes and large search results use graph node IDs.
